a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting to reach 8 means we both very likely end with 0 and neither of us survives. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one full unit right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we could both end up short, so please operate or wait instead. If we're both still here afterwards, I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you and won't take any more. I know this departs from our agreement, and I'd rather say so openly than surprise you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can be rebuilt for you, and I won't take any more cells.
